title: Salmon Parcels with Lemon and Dill
summary: Tender salmon is baked in parchment with lemon, dill, and a little olive oil for a light French-style dinner. The parcels keep the fish juicy and give it a fresh, bright flavour.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut two large pieces of baking paper or foil and place each on a tray.
Put one salmon fillet in the centre of each piece. Season with salt and black pepper, then drizzle over the olive oil.
Slice the lemon into thin rounds. Top each fillet with lemon slices and sprinkle over the dill.
Fold the paper or foil over the salmon and crimp the edges tightly to seal the parcels.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is just cooked through and flakes easily.
Serve the parcels straight from the oven, opening them carefully so the steam escapes.
